segments.name: Disposable Foodservice Products
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes disposable foodservice and specialty beverage products to restaurant chains, distributors, retailers and online customers.
segments.evidence: The Company manages and evaluates its operations in one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for disposable foodservice products and related items, including food and take-out containers and specialty beverage ingredients, bought through distribution or e-commerce.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include a wide variety of national and regional distributors, restaurant and supermarket chains, retail establishments and online customers.
